correctness.rationale: The inspected package derives an exact one-parameter fidelity formula from the source Kraus family. At the canonical angle, the trace factor has zero first derivative, so only the second source term contributes. Its derivative reduces to a positive prefactor times \((1-g)^2-(d-1)^2a^2g\). Independent symbolic reconstruction in this audit simplifies that expression exactly to \(p(d^2-1+p)/(d(d+1)^2)>0\). The package verifier also constructs the full Kraus operators and decoder and numerically checks the scalar formula against direct entanglement-fidelity evaluation for several dimensions and noise strengths. Hence the positive directional derivative is a genuine feasible improvement, sufficient to rule out stationarity and exact pair optimality.
